snippet.title: Adorable Adventures – Launch Trailer | Available Now
snippet.description:
Adorable Adventures is available now on PC (Steam & Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. 

Explore a hand‑crafted national park inspired by the Cévennes, follow Boris the baby boar’s scent‑tracking abilities, and discover gentle puzzles, hidden paths, and heartwarming story moments.

This launch trailer highlights gameplay variety, cozy exploration, and the heart of Boris’s journey

Trust your nose. Follow the trail. Find your family.

🎮 About the Game

- Cozy third‑person exploration
- Scent‑tracking mechanic to follow trails and uncover secrets
- Gentle puzzles and environmental storytelling
- A heartfelt journey to reunite a baby boar family
- Inspired by real landscapes from the Cévennes National Park

Supported by CNC and Montpellier Mediterranee Metropole


🕹️ Demo available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4006020/Adorable_Adventures_Demo/

🌿 Buy Now
Available on: Steam, Epic Games Store, PS5, Xbox Series X|S
Price: £16.99 / €19.99 / $19.99
Launch Discount (20% off until 13 May 2026): £13.59 / €15.99 / $15.99
Like, subscribe, and hit the bell for more updates, gameplay, and behind‑the‑scenes insights.

Check out these playlists for more of our content and behind the scenes look:
